# Breakpoints

<Description>
	Built-in breakpoints allow you to easily build adaptive layouts.
</Description>

## Available sizes

Each breakpoint matches a fixed screen width. Values are `min-width` based and apply when the screen width is equal or greater.

<ThemesBreakpointsTable />

## Usage

Most component size and layout props will accept an additional `Responsive` object shape for modifying the given prop across breakpoints.

Each size maps to a corresponding key, the value of each will be applied when the screen size is greater than or equal to the named breakpoint.

```jsx
<Heading size={{
    initial: "3",
    md: "5",
    xl: "7"
  }} />
```

## PostCSS plugins

The package's CSS files are compiled, so importing them needs no PostCSS setup. The `postcss-breakpoints` and `postcss-whitespace` plugins are only for teams that build their own responsive `rt-r-` classes the way Themes does. `postcss` is an optional peer dependency, so install it when you use a plugin:

```bash
pnpm add -D postcss@^8.5.9
```

```mjs
// postcss.config.mjs
import breakpoints from "@wsagency/radix2solid-themes/postcss-breakpoints";

export default { plugins: [breakpoints()] };
```

CommonJS configs can `require("@wsagency/radix2solid-themes/postcss-breakpoints")`. The plugin expands each `@breakpoints` block into one `@media` rule per breakpoint and prefixes the `rt-r-` classes inside it with the breakpoint name, for example `.xs\:rt-r-size-2`.
